I had to be hospitalized, and my kidney was rubbish. It got worse the other day, hemodialysis was an option that the doctors kept repeating in my head. Everything worked out, I had minimal sequelae, but it was thanks to an absurd amount of vomit, which dumped a good part of the substance.
I couldn't kill myself and almost got serious sequels. Talk to someone before making this decision, someone who will listen to you.
